data.name: Manifest Spirit
data.description: A wilderness explorer is shielded from magic by those guardian spirits that favor him. He gains spell resistance %1. This ability functions only while the wilderness explorer is within one of his favored terrains. This alters favored terrain even further.|11+RangerLVL
